newsitem.title: UK: Air Action appoints international mail manager.
newsitem.headline: Air Action appoints international mail manager.

text.p: Air Action, the London-based freight forwarder and courier group, has appointed Zena Jones as general manager of international mail direct, a company statement said.
Previously, she worked with Deltec and she takes on her new role as Air Action moves into a new development phase involving the franchising of their international courier business, it added.
Jones said: "I plan to develop growth from the existing customers as well as developing a new client base."
